# Rehan Malik, AI/ML Engineer

> Senior AI/ML Engineer specializing in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs),
> Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and production ML systems.

## Who is Rehan Malik?

Rehan Malik is an AI/ML engineer focused on building production AI systems.
He currently works at Reallytics.ai and Verticiti, focusing on agentic AI,
LLM fine-tuning, and real-time voice AI infrastructure.

## Core Expertise

- **AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems**: LangChain, function calling, planning loops, guardrails
- **RAG Pipelines**: FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, cross-encoder re-ranking, enterprise search
- **LLM Fine-Tuning**: LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF, DPO, PPO, cost-efficient alternatives to hosted APIs
- **Voice AI**: Real-time speech-to-text, high-concurrency streaming, Kafka, gRPC, CUDA
- **MLOps**: AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, model monitoring
- **Explainable AI**: SHAP, UMAP, ensemble methods, fraud detection
